P323.status: [Proven] matching primal-dual extremizer theorem; [Strong evidence] 90-digit FIN evaluation
P323.certificate: Let g(x)=x^3+c2*x^2+c1*x+c0 be orthogonal to 1,x,x^2 under shifted moments h1,...,h6. Its three roots r_i and Gaussian weights v_i give positive weights u_i=v_i/r_i. The signed measure sum u_i delta_ri - N delta_0 matches h0,...,h6. The dual polynomial p=-(g/g(0))^2 lies in [-1,0] on [0,1] and its value equals N, proving optimality by weak duality.
P323.boundary: The structural optimality implication is theorem-grade. The displayed decimal evaluation uses high precision rather than a fully kernel-checked algebraic-number library.

P324.status: [Proven] source-independent nonidentification; [Strong evidence] three explicit positive parent witnesses
P324.theorem: If two distinct admissible targets share exactly the same legacy input, no deterministic completion F(K_legacy) can be certified as producing both. A block parent can be built for each target, but its cross law sqrt(A_L)sqrt(A_T) reads that target and therefore is a representation, not a source-independent derivation.
P324.boundary: The theorem proves underdetermination from legacy input alone. It does not prohibit a new independent law or datum that selects one target.

P325.status: [Proven] exact refreeze-lattice provenance; [Refuted] current internal-source interpretation of 1/4000
P325.theorem: The additive subgroup of Q generated by the QW2030 center 187/800,-11/80 and QW2038 steps 2/125,1/20 is exactly (1/4000)Z. The selected row has coordinates 743 and 650. Thus exp(i/4000) is the minimal exact generator of the procedural refreeze lattice.
P325.boundary: A procedural provenance theorem is not an ontological or dynamical source theorem. The grid imported its base points, step sizes, objective, and physical-data gates.

P327.construction: Begin at uniform radial weights 1/6, where all six mode values equal 2. Assign ranks (-5,-3,-1,1,3,5) in any order, add the unique common shift preserving sum(weights)=1, and pull the perturbation back through the exact inverse mode matrix with epsilon=1/100.
P327.boundary: The theorem classifies order chambers of the positive radial simplex. It does not assign physical probability to chambers or select the frozen strict chamber.

P328.status: [Proven] commuting-unitary one-time diamond distance; [Blocked] full adaptive multitime comb
P328.theorem: For unitary channels U,V, half the diamond norm equals sqrt(1-nu^2), where nu is the distance from zero to the convex hull of the eigenvalues of U*V. For points on the unit circle this is determined by the shortest containing arc; an arc of length at least pi gives distance one.
P328.boundary: This is a one-use wave-channel result. A multitime comb requires declared interventions, memory system, common input/output spaces, and an SDP-capable implementation.
